name: Alt Mösern
kurzbeschreibung: Welcome to Alt Mösern in Telfs Nestled in the heart of Tirol, just a short drive from Innsbruck, Alt Mösern is a charming alpine village that invites you to experience the magic…
beschreibung: Alt Mösern in Telfs is a popular restaurant that delights its guests with a diverse menu and authentic regional hospitality. The ambiance blends traditional Tyrolean charm with modern comfort, creating a welcoming atmosphere for any occasion. The menu features carefully selected dishes—from classic Tyrolean specialties like Tiroler Gröstl and Kaiserschmarrn to international favorites. The team places special emphasis on using fresh, locally sourced ingredients from the surrounding area. Whether it’s a cozy dinner for two, a family celebration, or a business meeting, Alt Mösern warmly welcomes you and ensures a memorable stay with attentive service.
